reading_note: The arc moves from the structural framework of regenerate life (pillars, firmaments, angels surrounding the cosmos) through the discrete degrees of reception (Mind, Youth, twelve and twenty-two angels), into the inner economy of the Calling and Hearing — the divine influx descending and the human response ascending. These are revealed not as the First Man (divine truth itself) but as those affections and perceptions that became helpers when divine truth descended into self-love and was rescued by the Mother of Life. The teaching ends by showing that the same redeeming process operates wherever the Living Soul (truth from heaven) is mingled with what is dead — in the natural mind (tree) or in the flesh (ultimates of the body).
